analyzed_vuln.description: `parse_linknodes()` performs unchecked iterator increments between integer fields. After reading `startReps`, it does `++first` without verifying that `first<last` and that the separator is actually `'.'`; it repeats the same pattern before reading optional `idx2`. With malformed/truncated LN blocks, `first` can be advanced to `last` (or beyond valid range for wrapped iterators), and the subsequent `read_int()` loop dereferences `*first`, causing the ASan stack-buffer-overflow seen in `read_int()`.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Input must reach CXSMILES extension parsing (`... |LN:...|`) via `SmilesToMol` -> `handleCXPartAndName` -> `parseCXExtensions` -> `parse_it` -> `parse_linknodes`. A malformed LN record that omits/invalidates expected separators/number fields (e.g. `LN:6:6` followed by non-digit/invalid byte before closing `|`, as in the PoC) leaves the iterator at end and then `parse_linknodes` increments it and calls `read_int`, triggering out-of-bounds read.
